newsitem.title: CROATIA: CROATIAN PRIVATE GRADSKA BANKA TO BOOST CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: CROATIAN PRIVATE GRADSKA BANKA TO BOOST CAPITAL.

text.p: Croatia's private Gradska Banka plans to increase its equity capital by 55.5 million kuna to 120.7 million, a bank official said on Friday.

"We have obtained approval by State Securities Commission to raise our capital. The bank is constantly growing and the equity had to be boosted," Bosko Kujavic, a member of Gradska's board, told Reuters by telephone.
The bank plans to issue 5,000 ordinary shares and 10,000 preference shares with a guaranteed annual dividend of 7.0 percent. Nominal value of shares is put at 3,700 kuna.
The subscription will begin on September 1 and will last for 90 days, but the bank will allow payments within nine months, Kujavic said.
Gradska Banka is based in the eastern town of Osijek but has branch offices in all bigger towns in Croatia. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
